```sql
SELECT pl.sku, p.product_name, p.pack_size, SUM(pl.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) AS bills
FROM store.pos_lines pl
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = pl.sku
WHERE pl.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND pl.bill_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' AND pl.bill_timestamp < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY pl.sku, p.product_name, p.pack_size;
```
